newsitem.title: UK: Eurostar UK plans 26 trains a day from June 1.
newsitem.headline: Eurostar UK plans 26 trains a day from June 1.

text.p: Eurostar (UK) Ltd said on Friday it plans to operate 26 trains a day through the Channel Tunnel from June 1 compared with 21 at present.

Announcing its summer timetable, the company said daily services to Paris will be increased to 17 from 13 and to Brussels to eight from seven. There will continue to be a daily direct train to Disneyland Paris.
It said that following the full re-opening of the tunnel after last November's fire, journey times are being restored to three hours to Paris and 3-1/4 hours to Brussels from London.
"This is the best service we have ever offered to our customers," managing director Hamish Taylor said.
Eurostar (UK) is owned by the London and Continental Railways consortium which includes National Express Group Plc and Virgin Group. -- London Newsroom +44 171 5427950
